text: Some lower end routers/modems may still be MIPS and some set top boxes/media players are as well.
Ignore the plugin install then. Download links for text/slides/video are available in a number of formats in the bottom right hand corner of the page.
IIRC these clones may not be able to play all games - especially ones with add-on chips (Super Mario RPG is the only example I can think of right now)

Maybe GitHub for Windows will alleviate some of the problems with bad key handling, but I wonder if a few strategically logged bug reports with GitExtensions and TortoiseGit would go a fair way to fixing a lot of the friction people experience.
